label: Послать
description: A 10-sentence conjugation card for послать (to send). Irregular perfective: future пошлю/пошлёшь with the -шл- stem, past послал/послала/послали, imperative пошли.

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Perfective future, first person. 'Пошлю' is the 1sg non-past of perfective послать, used with future meaning. Notice the stem jump from infinitive посла- to the future root пошл-. 'Тебе' is the dative recipient.
Strategic focus: Perfective future, second person. 'Пошлёшь' is the 2sg future of послать, on the irregular пошл- stem with the stressed ё. 'Мне' marks the dative recipient of the photos.
Strategic focus: Perfective future, third person. 'Пошлёт' is the 3sg future of послать. The imperfective partner посылать would describe repeated sending, but here one completed dispatch is meant.

missions.phrase: Мы пошлём ему подарок по почте.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Perfective future, first-person plural. 'Пошлём' is the 1pl future of послать, end-stressed on the ё. 'Ему' is the dative recipient; 'по почте' uses по + dative for 'by mail'.

Strategic focus: Masculine past. 'Послал' is the masculine past of послать, built on the regular past stem посла- with no ё. 'Внуку' is the dative recipient. Note how the past stem differs from the future пошл-.

missions.phrase: Она послала сообщение и ждала ответа.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Feminine past. 'Послала' is the feminine past of послать on the посла- stem. Past tense tracks gender, not person. 'Ждала ответа' shows ждать governing the genitive.
Strategic focus: Plural past. 'Послали' is the plural past of послать on the regular посла- stem. 'Детей' is the accusative object; 'в лагерь' uses в + accusative for the destination.

Strategic focus: Singular imperative. 'Пошли' is the informal command from послать, built on the пошл- stem plus -и. 'Ему' is the dative recipient. Take care - this form is spelled like the plural past of идти, but context distinguishes them.
Strategic focus: Plural or polite imperative. 'Пошлите' is the formal command of послать, adding -те to the пошл- stem. 'В отдел' uses в + accusative for the destination of the request.
Strategic focus: Infinitive use. 'Послать' is the bare infinitive, here governed by 'забыл'. It names the act of sending; 'ему' is the dative recipient. The imperfective infinitive would be посылать.
